name: NGC 2005 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2005, a globular cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2005-hubble
story: A globular cluster near the heart of the Large Magellanic Cloud, its stars chemically unlike their neighbors: an ancient witness to a long-past merger of galaxies.

claims.text: It lies near the heart of the Large Magellanic Cloud
Its stars are chemically distinct from the surrounding LMC stars; it is an ancient witness to a long-past merger
NGC 2005 is a target of program 12257 (Magellanic Cloud star clusters), at RA 05 30 10.0, Dec -69 45 07.8
